title: Eleven Minutes to Prove
subtitle: 能力与胜任 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 能力与胜任（生活与学习·能力与素养）
meta: 主题语境：能力与胜任（生活与学习·能力与素养）　|　核心词汇：competence　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 competence 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1967 my mother ① showed a competence in accounts that no certificate of hers mentioned, and she said the showing was the whole of the interview. The ② competence, meaning the doing and not the paper, took eleven minutes to prove and stayed proved; competence, she said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how little it is written down.

Every ③ competence in that file had the same date, and the ④ competence at the end, meaning the one she kept for the audits and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever tested twice. Competence, my grandmother said, is nine parts doing and one part somebody willing to be tested; my mother said the doing is the part that fills the file.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the competence of the court was the whole of the case, meaning the power to hear it and not the skill. The ⑥ competence, meaning the power and not any of that, is the only thing in a case that everybody argues about and nobody demonstrates; competence, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both a doing and a power. She said the power is the part they remember.

By 1975 the ⑦ competence had become a line in a job description, and the description had become an argument about the date. The ⑧ competence of the whole thing, my mother wrote in January, was one interview and thirty years of doing; competence, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to be tested. He said the testing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ competence I remember is the one at the end, which she showed in 1981 and is still described as the least written down in the county. A ⑩ competence, my grandmother said in 1983, is the only thing that improves by being tested; every competence, she said, is a doing that has agreed to look like a power. She said the doing was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 能力（指那种做得成事本身，与那张证书相对）
C. 固定搭配：show a competence in 在……方面表现出能力
D. n. 能力（指那份档案里每一项）
E. n. 能力（指末尾那一项）
F. n. 权限；职权（指法庭受理案件的权力）
G. n. 能力（指岗位说明里提到的那一项）
H. n. 胜任力；素养（抽象总称）

items.q: The competence, meaning the doing and not the paper
the competence of the court was the whole of the case
the competence had become a line in a job description
The competence of the whole thing
A competence, my grandmother said in 1983

answers.why: show a competence in 意为“在……方面表现出能力”，1967 年母亲在账务上表现出一种她任何证书都没写的能力。
competence 意为“能力”，指那种做得成事本身而不是那张证书，它花了十一分钟就被证明了。
competence 指那份档案里每一项能力，每一项都写着同样的日期。
competence 指末尾那一项（她留给查账的那一套本事），是唯一有人考过两次的。
competence 意为“权限、职权”，父亲说法院的受理权限就是那个案子的全部，指的是那种权力而不是那种本事。
competence 为另一个义项，指那种权力而不是那种本事，是案子里人人争论、却无人演示的东西。
competence 意为“能力”，指岗位说明里提到的那一项，到 1975 年这种能力成了岗位说明里的一行。
competence 意为“胜任力、素养”，母亲一月写道，整件事的胜任力是一场面试三十年的做事。
competence 意为“能力、胜任”，我记得的是末尾那一项，她 1981 年表现出的，至今仍被说成全县最不被写下来的。
competence 为抽象总称，祖母说一种能力是唯一会因为被考验而变好的东西。
